tools.name: find_raaga
tools.description: Look up a raaga by name, in any spelling (with or without diacritics, "raga"/"ragam"/"raag"). Returns its scale, parent, notes, key notes, songs, what it is confused with, and its page.

tools.name: raagas_with_notes
tools.description: Find the raagas that use a set of notes: those whose scale is exactly these notes, and those whose notes include them. Carnatic labels (S R1 R2 G2 G3 M1 M2 P D1 D2 N2 N3) or Hindustani letters (S r R g G m M P d D n N: lowercase komal, M tivra).

tools.name: list_raagas
tools.description: The 70 raagas twelveswaras knows (40 Carnatic, 30 Hindustani), with their parent and page.

tools.name: identify_raaga
tools.description: Name the raaga in a recording of Carnatic or Hindustani music at a public http(s) URL (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm; up to 25 MB). Returns the top three with confidence, the tonic (Sa) it heard, and each raaga's page. Best with a minute or more and a drone. The recording is not stored.
